name: NBEP Design, Engineering and Permitting Grants
summary: EPA-funded awards for design, engineering and permitting that move water quality and habitat restoration projects in the Narragansett Bay region toward construction. Reimbursement basis, no match needed.

status.quote: with a proposal due date of Friday, October 2, 2026

deadline.quote: with a proposal due date of Friday, October 2, 2026

administered_by.quote: The Narragansett Bay Estuary Program (NBEP), through its host, Roger Williams University (RWU), is issuing this RFP

geography.quote: within the Narragansett Bay, Little Narragansett Bay, and Coastal Ponds watersheds in Rhode Island, Massachusetts, and Connecticut (Narragansett Bay region)

access.quote: is issuing this RFP for design, engineering, and permitting activities to advance water quality and habitat restoration and enhancement projects

window.quote: with a proposal due date of Friday, October 2, 2026

amount.quote: NBEP expects individual awards to range from approximately $50,000 to $250,000

co_finance_required.quote: All funds are provided on a reimbursement basis. Match is not required.
